_readme: Staging on Supabase Cloud (project cwrkquzuuyhfhesozqnb, free plan) to test the server login and RLS before the VPS exists. Served locally: staff = http://localhost:PORT, customer = http://127.0.0.1:PORT (same files, the hostname picks the mode). Build: node tools/build-web.js --config=staging.config.json --out=webstaging --strict
